articles.title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
articles.snippet: Pablo Hernández de Cos, chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors blockchain-based banking and has warned against private digital currencies and banks holding bitcoin.

articles.title: Brazil’s stock exchange teams up with major banks to launch real-pegged stablecoin
articles.snippet: Banco B3 will issue the token, backed one-to-one by reais, and other financial institutions can join from launch.

articles.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
articles.snippet: The vaults that would hold lenders' money are on track to switch on Dec. 9. The loan system that draws from them still needs one more validator to start its own two-week clock.

articles.title: Brazil’s stock exchange pushes stablecoin launch back to 2027
articles.snippet: Brazil’s stock exchange is working with six major financial institutions on a real-backed stablecoin that could launch as early as the first quarter of 2027.

articles.title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
articles.snippet: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.
